definitions.explanation: A gain or favorable outcome, especially financial profit or practical advantage. Appears frequently as a component in compound words.
Interest paid on borrowed money or earned on savings. Used in financial contexts, particularly in compound nouns.

examples.japanese: {利|り}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{害|がい}→害：02542_gai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Weigh the benefits and drawbacks before making a decision.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定期預金|ていきよきん}→定期預金：22251_teikiyokin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利|り}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The interest on the fixed deposit went up from last month.

examples.english: There is also the view that one should uphold righteousness rather than chase profit.

examples.english: In an era of low interest rates, deposits earn almost no interest.

notes:
Most commonly encountered as a component of compound nouns rather than as a standalone word.

COMMON COMPOUNDS (sense 1 — profit/benefit):
- ⟦{利害|りがい}→利害：04091_rigai⟧: pros and cons; interests and harms
- ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧: profit; benefit
- ⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧: advantageous
- ⟦{不利|ふり}→不利：03603_furi⟧: disadvantageous
- ⟦{利口|りこう}→利口：03801_rikou⟧: clever; bright

COMMON COMPOUNDS (sense 2 — interest):
- ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: interest rate
- {低金利|ていきんり}: low interest rate
- ⟦{利子|りし}→利子：17606_rishi⟧: interest (on a loan)
